title: Penthouse Magazine October 1987 Jessica Hahn Sheila Kennedy Vintage
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, October 1987 issue — Exclusive: Jessica Hahn's Own Story (her account of the PTL/Jim Bakker scandal), Pet of the Month Sheila Kennedy. Also features "20 Worst Football Teams," "Human Guinea Pigs — Medicine's Dirtiest Secret," and Dashiell Hammett's "Woman in the Dark."
Complete issue, no missing pages noted. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
